ValidationRule.description: The Account must have "KYC Status" as Approved
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name <> "Bank-PSP Partner", RecordType.Name <> "Agents", RecordType.Name <> "Strategic Partner", Opp_Product_Family__c = "Cross Border", Probability > 0.95, OR ( Account.Client_Legal_Entity_Name__c = "", ISBLANK(ContractId), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Account.KYC_Status__c , "Approved")) ) )&& Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: *** KYC Team must mark 'KYC Status' as Approved on the Account Record. Client Legal Entity on Account must be filled in and Contract record must be linked ***
